# Summary

<!-- What does this change, and why? Link any issue it closes: "Closes #12". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (existing behaviour or configuration changes)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / dependencies

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands you ran, cases you covered, and anything you verified by hand. -->

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one concern
- [ ] Comments explain *why* where the reasoning isn't obvious
- [ ] Logging goes through `Logger`, not `console.*`
- [ ] **No personal data or secrets** added to source, tests, or fixtures
- [ ] Tests added for new logic and for any bug being fixed
- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/`) if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
